vulnerability_type: Owner Privilege Abuse - Excessive Fee Manipulation

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner with onlyOwner access
Token must have active trading on Uniswap pair with users attempting transactions
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true for fee collection and distribution

exploit_hint: As contract owner, call setBuyTaxes() or setSelTaxes() to set fee percentages to extreme values (e.g., 90-100%). When users buy or sell tokens through the Uniswap pair, the excessive fees are collected by the contract. Through the swapAndLiquify() mechanism, these tokens are swapped for BNB and distributed to marketingWalletAddress and teamWalletAddress which the owner controls, resulting in direct financial extraction from user transactions.
